paras: Canh's gecko (Gekko canhi) is a species of lizard in the family Gekkonidae. The species is endemic to Vietnam.
The specific name, canhi, is in honor of Vietnamese ecologist Le Xuan Canh.
G. canhi is found in Lang Son Province and Lao Cai Province, in northern Vietnam.
The preferred natural habitat of G. canhi is forest, at altitudes of 200–1,500 m (660–4,920 ft).
Medium-sized for its genus, the snout-to-vent length of an adult G. canhi does not exceed 10 cm (3.9 in).
